title: Season-level latent team-strength uncertainty in the playoff/title simulator
current_method: Weekly team scores drawn independently N(mean, sd) around a FIXED per-team mean; no per-season draw of the team mean; MC error + Wilson CIs only
evidence: Code ~lines 1640-1650 draw rng.gauss(dist.mean, dist.sd) per week; SIM_CALIBRATION_V3_RESULTS UNRESOLVED: playoff odds 0/1 for every team after week 7 in the harness, presim means 117-507 vs realized ~200-460
baseline: Champion fixed-mean sim (D11 incumbent and corrected arms); strong simple baseline: inflate weekly sd by sqrt(1 + n*tau^2/sigma^2)
proposed: Draw team-mean offset u_t ~ N(0, tau_t^2) once per simulated season from a normal-normal posterior (prior presim/league mean, likelihood scored weeks); optional local-level Kalman drift
mechanism: Season-total variance becomes n*sigma^2 + n^2*tau^2 instead of n*sigma^2, de-saturating odds and every downstream consumer (pick projector, posture, FAAB status)
data_available: Public Sleeper matchups 2024-2026 via previous_league_id chain; 2026 forecast archive (src/ros/forecast_archive.py)
data_missing: Point-in-time rosValue before 2026-07-14 (presim arm 2026-only); only 3 seasons
consumers: rosPlayoffOdds/playoffOdds/rosChampionship, pick_projection, pick_market, window.competitive_posture, FAAB competitive status, simulate_trade_impact
risk: Methodology change to a published probability; must not be conflated with D11 or V3; owner-gated
evaluation: POC-1: origin-week walk-forward; primary log score of weekly matchup win probabilities (~250 games, season-week block bootstrap) and RPS of final-seed distributions; Holm over 2 endpoints; size-controlled gates (AM-ROSTER-02)
acceptance: Matchup log-score gain 95% CI > 0, seed RPS not worse, reliability slope toward 1, holds under D11-corrected arm
rejection: Log-score CI <= 0, unstable tau across folds (CV > 50%), or gain vanishes under D11-corrected arm
related_roadmap: D11 (Owner Decision 11 / TODO D2); MD-11; SIM_CALIBRATION V1-V3; baseline matrix row 6
novelty_note: New codebase finding not recorded in baseline docs, D11 or V3 (which address double counting and player-level marginals)

title: Component-first calibration ladder with size-controlled gates
current_method: Per-family KS / PIT coverage gates at family sizes 56-95; season odds judged on 12 team-weeks
evidence: SIM_CALIBRATION_V3_RESULTS: a perfectly calibrated model passes SC-G4 0.2% and SC-G1 16% of the time at week-7 sizes; gate sizing left as an owner methodology decision
baseline: Current gates; simple baseline: pooled PIT test + proper-score skill CIs
proposed: Admit a gate only if a calibrated synthetic model passes >= 90% at actual n; evaluate weekly matchup probabilities and team-week CRPS (n in hundreds) as primary, season odds as derived/descriptive; Holm multiplicity; season-week block bootstrap
mechanism: Moves adjudication to where effective n exists and removes gates that reject truth by construction
consumers: Every future calibration challenger in this lane (sim points model, playoff odds, pick-market c, ROS scale)
risk: Could be misread as weakening gates; it strengthens them by making size and power explicit
evaluation: Operating-characteristic table for each proposed gate at real sample sizes; re-read V3 week-7/8 evidence descriptively only (no promotion)
acceptance: Every admitted gate has calibrated-model pass rate >= 90% and stated power vs a named alternative
rejection: No admissible gate has useful power at available n -> declare calibration BLOCKED rather than run unadjudicable tests
novelty_note: Generalizes an issue V3 disclosed but left open

title: Point-in-time FAAB market refit with winner-censored (order-statistic) likelihood
current_method: Zero-inflated lognormal per rival, independent; parameters matched to band quantiles of WINNING bids joined to TODAY's values, below all-in only; above-all-in asserted
evidence: docs/faab-model.md 9.3: 2100-2600 band model $0 share 0.6% vs observed 45.8%; 2600+ 0.1% vs 62.5%; limitation 2 'above the all-in line the market model is unvalidated'; limitation 4 losing bids never exposed
baseline: Shipped faab.json (champion); nonparametric per-band empirical winning-bid distribution (strong simple baseline)
proposed: Join post-2026-07-14 claims to as-of canonical values via src/history; fit theta by the likelihood of the observed MAXIMUM over all N managers (interval-censored to $1), hierarchical band offsets, priors centred on shipped config
mechanism: Uses the actual selection mechanism (only the max is observed) instead of treating winners as typical bids; removes look-ahead bias
data_available: Box-local data/faab/bid_history_<league>.json; temporal ledger since HISTORY_FLOOR 2026-07-14
data_missing: Claim count after 2026-07-14 unknown in this worktree; losing bids; roster/balance state at claim time
consumers: optimal_bid, clearing band on /waivers, advisor, Perfect Waivers
risk: Small n; above-all-in may stay non-identified; a refit is a config change requiring owner approval
evaluation: POC-2: leave-one-waiver-week-out held-out log score of winning bid; P($0) calibration per band; expected-surplus regret
acceptance: Log-score gain CI > 0 vs champion and not worse than nonparametric baseline; P($0) within +/-5pp per band
rejection: No gain, posterior ~ prior above all-in, or < 150 joined claims (BLOCKED)
novelty_note: Order-statistic likelihood for winner-only FAAB data not found in repo docs; standard idea in auction econometrics (PUBLISHED-EXTERNAL: Athey & Haile 2002, Econometrica 70(6))

title: Uncertainty-derived no-action threshold for streaming
current_method: Fixed materialityPoints = 1.0 projected point over the horizon (PRIOR)
evidence: streaming.json rationale is prose only; gap decomposition: provider IDP bias -1.1..-1.6, DL calibration slope 0.72, coverage 56-62% of scoring defender-weeks
baseline: Fixed 1.0; conservative arm (materiality 3) already in harness
proposed: Act iff E[dL] - z*SD(dL) > c_txn where SD(dL) aggregates projection-error variance of every swapped player across weighted horizon weeks; z and c_txn fit on training weeks to minimise realized regret
mechanism: Threshold scales with the plan's real forecast uncertainty (a 3-swap 4-week plan is far noisier than 1 swap for 1 week)
data_available: streaming_point_in_time projection error rows; existing paired backtest harness
data_missing: More decision weeks (n=6 in 2026); prospective archive w9+ (MD-30)
consumers: /waivers streaming tab, recommendedCapacity
risk: With today's weak forecast the rule mostly says NO ACTION; benefit is false-churn reduction
evaluation: Paired harness: false-churn rate, realized lift vs base 7 and hold, block bootstrap by week
acceptance: False churn down with realized lift not worse (CI) than base 7
rejection: Lift worse, or indistinguishable with no churn reduction
related_roadmap: MD-7; MD-8; MD-19; IST-5; baseline AMATH-2 (sub-component, not duplicate)
novelty_note: Concrete calibrated threshold; baseline names an uncertainty-aware negative control but not this rule

title: Defer Wasserstein DRO / CVaR streaming until forecasts have PIT skill (value-of-information gate)
current_method: Exact deterministic add/drop search on mean projections
evidence: IDP_STREAMING_GAP_DECOMPOSITION_2026-11-01: all guards relaxed +3.71 vs base +0.40; hindsight (realized points) +52.7 under every guard
proposed: Do not build a DRO/CVaR decision layer now; re-open when a forecast passes PIT calibration and the VOI bound (hindsight minus decision-relaxed) shows decision-side headroom
mechanism: Decision layer owns ~+3.3 of ~+52.3 hindsight headroom; forecast quality dominates
data_missing: A calibrated weekly IDP forecast (S1/S2, MD-20)
consumers: Baseline AMATH-2 / S4 sequencing
risk: Complex robust optimisation on uncalibrated inputs adds complexity without measurable gain
evaluation: Recompute the VOI bound whenever a new forecast challenger is evaluated
acceptance: Re-open when decision-side headroom > 5 pts/decision-week with a calibrated forecast
novelty_note: Re-sequences baseline AMATH-2 (89/100) using evidence published after the baseline was scored

title: Roster Fragility Index (exact-lineup lower-tail risk)
current_method: BBLI reports a mean delta with MC SE; independence across players; 'uncertain' players kept in pool; no tail metric
evidence: best_ball_utility docstring: 'Still not modelled: probability that an uncertain player plays, and player-to-player correlation'; V3-D4 same-NFL-team tau^2 ~0.017 vs roster-wide 0.008
baseline: Bye-week grid + count of startable players per slot (simple baseline)
proposed: Index = (E[F] - CVaR_10%[F]) / E[F] per week/season from draw->solve with bye calendar, P(plays) for uncertain players and one same-NFL-team shared shock; report fragile weeks and the collapsing slot
principle: 6 dependence (single factor); 10 CVaR as descriptive risk measure; 9 availability as explicit state
mechanism: Reuses BBLI pairing and canonical lineup/availability owners; no second model
data_available: Rosters, availability owner, sim points model, NFL schedule
data_missing: Calibrated P(plays) for 'uncertain'; validated weekly variance model (V3 not promoted)
consumers: Private roster tools, Construction tab, future trade/waiver explanations
risk: Inherits points-model miscalibration; label uncalibrated until I2 verified
evaluation: Prospective: do high-fragility teams show larger realized lower-tail shortfalls over remaining 2026 weeks and 2027; rank correlation with realized bottom-decile weeks
acceptance: Spearman between predicted and realized lower-tail shortfall > 0 with CI excluding 0 over >= 100 team-weeks
rejection: No relationship, or the simple bye-grid baseline is equally predictive
novelty_note: Fragility named in owner intake FFBB-5 (not novel to repo); exact-lineup CVaR under superflex+IDP rules appears uncommon in commercial tools (uncertain novelty)

title: Drop-Regret Curve: empirical value-transition kernel replacing protection PRIORs
current_method: Ten PRIOR thresholds (churnGapMax 0.15, protectGapMin 0.40, youngAgeMax 24, snap thresholds, valueTrendUpMinRatio 0.15, ...) classify protected/conditional/churn
evidence: Appendix A read-only diagnostic on committed exports/archive (scraper composite): P(>=1.5x in 30d) 0.76% for 1000-1500 (926 pairs, 371 players), ~0.2% above 1500, 8.3% below 1000
baseline: Current PRIOR rules; simple baseline: value-band-only rule
proposed: K_H(v,x) = P(value_{t+H} >= k*v_t | band, age, usage trend, draft capital) from the canonical-board ledger; protect iff K_H * re-acquisition cost > expected streaming gain; publish '1 in N similar players gain 50% within 30 days'
principle: 5 sparsity (few features, monotone logistic); 9 missingness (unknown features keep blocking churn); 10 decision rule
mechanism: One stated probability replaces ten opaque thresholds; empirical support for protection
data_missing: Canonical-board rerun; football-role outcomes (snap share) as alternative target; > 1 season
consumers: Streaming composer drop side, advisor, Perfect Waivers
risk: Short in-season history; market lags role news (lower bound); user locks stay absolute and unpriced never dropped
evaluation: Fit Jul-Sep, validate Oct-Nov (time split); Brier of 30-day breakout; regret of drops recommended under each rule in the streaming harness
acceptance: Brier skill > 0 vs band-only baseline (block bootstrap CI) and no increase in regrettable drops in replay
rejection: No skill over band-only, or positive class too rare to estimate (< 30 events)
novelty_note: Genuinely original in repo: no existing doc estimates a value-transition kernel for drop safety
